armySpecialRules.name: Beastmen Breeds
armySpecialRules.description:
Beastmen are divided into Gors, Ungors, Centigors and
Minotaurs. Characters may only join units of the same
breed as themselves. In addition, Ungors do not cause
Panic in any of the other breeds above.

armySpecialRules.name: Bloodgreed
armySpecialRules.description:
Whenever a model with this special rule wins a round
of close combat in which it has caused at least one
unsaved Wound, it gains the Frenzy special rule until
the end of the next close combat phase. However, they
may never choose to Overrun. Bloodgreed has no
effect against Animated Constructs, Daemons, Forest
Spirits or Vampires.

armySpecialRules.name: Drunken
armySpecialRules.description:
Roll a D6 for each unit containing models with this
special rule at the beginning of each of their turns and
consult the table below to see what effect they have until
the start of their next turn:
D6 Result
1-2 Drunken Stupor: The unit is subject to the
Stupidity special rule.
3-4 Drunken Frenzy: The unit is subject to the
Frenzy special rule.
5-6 Drunken Bravado: The unit is subject to the
Stubborn special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: Marks Of Chaos
armySpecialRules.description:
Several characters and regiments in the Beastmen army
have, or can purchase, one of the four Marks of Chaos
detailed below. A character with a Mark of Chaos
cannot join a unit that has a different Mark of Chaos. A
character with a Mark of Chaos cannot join a unit that
has already been joined by a character that has a
different Mark of Chaos.
• Mark of Khorne: Models with the Mark of Khorne
have the Frenzy special rule.
• Mark of Nurgle: Models with the Mark of Nurgle
add +1 to their Toughness.
• Mark of Slaanesh: Models with the Mark of
Slaanesh have the Immunity (Psychology) special
rule and may re-roll the lowest dice on their charge
and pursuit distances.
• Mark of Tzeentch: Models with the Mark of
Tzeentch have the Magical Ward (6+) and Magic
Resistance (1) special rules.

armySpecialRules.name: Primal Fury
armySpecialRules.description:
At the beginning of each round of close combat, each
engaged unit with the Primal Fury special rule must
take a Leadership test. If the test is passed, that unit
gains the Hatred special rule until the end of the close
combat phase. In addition, if they passed the
Leadership test and rolled a double, they also gain the
Frenzy special rule until the end of the close combat
phase.

armySpecialRules.name: Tusker Charge
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Mighty Blow (1)
special rule in any turn that they charge.

armySpecialRules.name: Unruly
armySpecialRules.description:
All models with this special rule follow the Berserk
Rage rules from Frenzy. In addition, if they are forced
to charge as a result of a failed Berserk Rage test, they
may re-roll failed charge distance results.

magicItems.name: Axes Of Khorgor
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons. The bearer may re-roll all failed
rolls To Hit and To Wound in close combat. In addition,
he gains the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Axe Of Men
magicItems.description:
The Axe of Men gives the wielder the Killing Blow
special rule. In addition, if the bearer kills an enemy
character in a challenge, they and any unit they are
with gain the Stubborn and Terror special rule for as
long as they remain with the unit.

magicItems.name: The Black Maul
magicItems.description:
The Black Maul adds +2 to the bearer's Strength and
gives him the Frenzy special rule. In addition, the
weapon ignores any rules that would otherwise destroy
the weapon.

magicItems.name: Slaughterer'S Blade
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Great weapon. For each wound
inflicted with the Slaughterer's Blade, roll a D6
immediately. Each roll of a 4+ heals one lost Wound to
the bearer (up to their starting Wounds total). Wounds
regained in this way do not count towards combat
resolution.

magicItems.name: Hunting Spear
magicItems.description:
Spear. The Hunting Spear can be thrown following the
rules for javelins with a range of 24" each Shooting
phase. Resolve each hit like a Hit from a bolt thrower.

magicItems.name: The Steel-Claws
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons. The Steel-Claws confer an extra
D3 Attacks to the wielder rather than 1 (roll at the
beginning of each round of close combat). If a natural 6
is rolled when determining the number of attacks, all
the bearer's attacks that round gain the Ignores Armour
Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: The Brass Cleaver
magicItems.description:
The Brass Cleaver gives the wielder +1 Attack for each
enemy model in base contact. In a challenge, it only
confers +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Mangelder
magicItems.description:
The bearer gains the Terror special rule. In addition,
any model wounded by this weapon loses 1 point of
Leadership for each Wound it suffers.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Beastmen.
in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Primeval Club
magicItems.description:
When rolling To Wound, the owner's Strength is treated
as equal to the unmodified Leadership value of the
target model. This affects any armour saves the model
might be required to take as well.

magicItems.name: Great Fang
magicItems.description:
The wielder of Great Fang gain +1 To Wound, and
enemies must re-roll successful Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Herdstone Axe
magicItems.description:
If the wielder of this weapon successfully Wounds an
enemy model, roll a D6 after resolving all their attacks.
On a 5+, that model is automatically slain with no
saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Stonecrusher Mace
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. The Mace always wounds on a 2+.
Armour saves are taken using the wielder's normal
Strength. Against Buildings, Chariots, Shrines and War
Machines, the wielder has the Multiple Wounds (D6)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Volcanic Axe
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains the Flaming Attacks
special rule. In addition, each time you roll a natural 6
To Hit with this weapon, that attack automatically
Wounds with the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Axe Of Morghur
magicItems.description:
No Magical Ward saves can be taken against Wounds
caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: Everbleed
magicItems.description:
Every time an enemy model suffers an unsaved wound
from Everbleed, roll a D6. On the result of a 4+, the
enemy loses an additional wound, with no saves of any
kind allowed, and you must roll again. Keep on rolling
as long as the result is a 4+.

magicItems.name: Jagged Dagger
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. Every enemy model killed in close
combat by the bearer of the Jagged Dagger generates
an additional Power or Dispel dice that can be used in
the next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Scimitar Of Skultar
magicItems.description:
All To Wound rolls of 6 with the Scimitar of Skultar
have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Trollhide Armour
magicItems.description:
Light armour. Trollhide Armour gives the wearer the
Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Slitherwrack Helm
magicItems.description:
6+ armour save. All enemy units in base contact with
the bearer are subject to the Always Strikes Last special
rule in the first round of Close Combat.

magicItems.name: Ramhorn Helm
magicItems.description:
6+ armour save. For every armour save the wearer
passes, the bearer may immediately make a bonus
attack at his basic Strength.

magicItems.name: Blackened Plate
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. The wearer of the Blackened Plate
gains the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule. Any
unit he joins gains a Magical Ward (4+) against non-
physical Flaming Attacks.

magicItems.name: Blade-Blunter Armour
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. At the end of each round of close
combat, roll a D6 for each magic weapon that Hit the
wearer of the armour. On the result of a 2+, the enemy
item loses its special rules and ceases to count as a
magic weapon. Instead it will count as a normal
weapon of its type for the remainder of the battle.

magicItems.name: Blackened Talisman Of Chaos
magicItems.description:
Whenever an enemy spell is casting within 12" of the
bearer of this item, deduct the highest roll from the
result.

magicItems.name: The Festerpelt
magicItems.description:
At the start of each turn, the bearer of this item
automatically restores 1 Wound suffered earlier during
game.

magicItems.name: Fur Of Sharrgu
magicItems.description:
This Fur gives the wearer the Magical Ward (5+). In
addition, they gain the Natural Armour (6+) special
rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Pelt Of The Shadowgave
magicItems.description:
All shooting attacks directed at the bearer or the unit he
is with suffer -1 To Hit. Enemy spells that target the
bearer or the unit he is with suffer -2 to cast.

magicItems.name: Ruinous Icon
magicItems.description:
Each time an enemy spell is cast on the bearer of this
item or their unit, roll a D6. On a 4+, the spell is
automatically dispelled.

magicItems.name: Eye Of Night
magicItems.description:
The Eye of Night gives the bearer and any unit they
join the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In addition,
if an enemy Wizard within 24" suffers a Miscast, you
may force them to re-roll the result on the Miscast
table.

magicItems.name: Glyph-Etched Talisman
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item channels dispel dice in the same
manner as a Level 2 Wizard. This has no effect on a
model that already is a Wizard.

magicItems.name: Pelt Of The Dark Young
magicItems.description:
The Pelt of the Dark Young gives the wearer the Magic
Resistance (1) and Natural Armour (6+) special rules.

magicItems.name: Shard Of The Herd Stone
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item may be used at the
start of any of your Magic phases. When used, place a
Herdstone (see Mystical Monuments in the
Warhammer Rulebook), no more than 3" in diameter,
within 6" of the Wizard. Beastmen units within 6" of a
Herdstone have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.
Each friendly Beastman Wizard within 12" of the
herdstone generates an additional power dice.

magicItems.name: Skull Of Rarkos
magicItems.description:
Relic. All friendly Beastman Wizards within 12"
(including the bearer himself) gain a +1 casting bonus.

magicItems.name: Chalice Of Dark Rain
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. At the beginning of the enemy
Shooting phase, the bearer can summon a storm of mud
and worms with which to blind his enemies. For the
rest of the phase, all enemy missile units are at -1 To
Hit. Weapons or attacks that do not use Ballistic Skill
may only fire on the roll of a 4+.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Darkoth
magicItems.description:
Staff. Bound spell. The Staff of Darkoth contains the
Viletide spell from the Lore of the Wild.

magicItems.name: Bleating Gnarlstaff
magicItems.description:
Staff. At the start of each of your Magic phases, pick
one terrain feature within 18" of the bearer. Any enemy
unit within 6" of that terrain feature suffer D6 Strength
4 Hits.

magicItems.name: Daemon Heart
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item may be used when
attempting to dispel. It automatically gives you a
number of dispel dice equal to the amount of power
dice used to cast the spell.

magicItems.name: The Plague Chalice
magicItems.description:
Relic. Mark of Nurgle only. The Shaman may drink
from the Plague Chalice at the start of his Magic phase.
He suffers an immediate Strength 4 hit that ignores all
saves. For the remainder of that Magic phase, any spell
casting attempt by the Shaman that includes any double
(except 1's) on the initial roll gives the caster another
free power dice to the casting attempt.

magicItems.name: Hagtree Fetish
magicItems.description:
Relic. Choose an enemy unit within 24" at the start of
each Magic phase. Any failed To Wound rolls made
during the Magic phase against that unit may be re-
rolled.

magicItems.name: Tanglehorn Familiars
magicItems.description:
One use only. This can be used at the start of any
enemy Magic phase. Pick one Wizard within 18", that
Wizard cannot cast any spells this turn.

magicItems.name: Horn Of The First Beast
magicItems.description:
Beastlords and Wargors only. All friendly units within
12" of the bearer of the Horn of the Great Beast may
re-roll failed Primal Fury tests.

magicItems.name: Horn Of The Great Hunt
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (Power Level 4). The Horn of the Great
Hunt contains the Bestial Surge spell from the Lore of
the Wild.

magicItems.name: Cornucopia Of Corpulence
magicItems.description:
All enemy models in base contact with the bearer must
pass a Toughness test at the start of each round of close
combat or suffer one Wound which Ignores Armour
Saves.

magicItems.name: The Dark Heart
magicItems.description:
The character and any unit led by him adds +D3" to
their charge move. Roll after declaring charges - if the
charge is failed, the models move their normal failed
charge distance.

magicItems.name: Stone Of Spite
magicItems.description:
One use only. Bound spell (Power Level 5). Every
Arcane Item within 18" is immediately destroyed
(friend and foe), and each bearer of an Arcane Item
suffers D6 Strength 4 hits per item lost.

magicItems.name: The Goretooth
magicItems.description:
The Goretooth gives the bearer the Hatred and
Bloodgreed special rules.

magicItems.name: Brayblast Trumpet
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of the
Remaining Moves sub-phase on your second turn.
When used, all friendly units with the Ambushers
special rule gain a +1 bonus when rolling to see if they
enter the battlefield that turn.

magicItems.name: Champion'S Doomcloak
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may re-roll failed Primal Fury
tests.

magicItems.name: Skin Of Man
magicItems.description:
Infantry only. The bearer of the Skin of Man gains the
Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: Bloodhunt Horn
magicItems.description:
One Use Only. Once per battle, the bearer can force a
fleeing enemy unit within 12" to automatically fail
their Rally test. This must be declared before the test is
made.

magicItems.name: Cacophonous Dirge
magicItems.description:
Enemy musicians within 12" of the bearer of the
Cacophonous Dirge have no effect.

magicItems.name: Gilded Horns
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The bearer of this item gains the
Impact Hits (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Knowing Eye
magicItems.description:
At the start of each of your turns, the bearer of this item
may choose one enemy unit within Line of Sight. That
unit must reveal any Hidden models, upgrades and
magic items it might have.

magicItems.name: The Beast Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gain a +1 bonus to their
Strength.

magicItems.name: The Flesh Banner
magicItems.description:
At the start of each close combat phase, all enemy units
in base contact with the unit carrying this standard
suffers D6 Strength 4 hits, distributed as Hits from
shooting. Any wounds caused by the Flesh Banner
counts towards combat resolution.

magicItems.name: Vitriolic Totem
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Poisoned
Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Manbane Standard
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 6" of the unit carrying this
standard suffer -1 to their Leadership characteristic.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Outrage
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard automatically pass all
Primal Fury and counts as having rolled doubles for it.
However, all enemy units gain the Hatred special rule
against the unit.

magicItems.name: Totem Of Wrath
magicItems.description:
In any turn that they charge, the unit carrying this
standard gains the Armour Piercing (1) special rule and
may re-roll 1's To Wound.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Warped Moon
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may take a Leadership
test at the start of any of your Movement phases. If the
test is passed, no units within 24" may use the Fly
special rule until the start of your next turn.

magicItems.name: The Gore Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed
Psychology tests.

magicItems.name: Totem Of Rust
magicItems.description:
All units (friend or foe) in base contact with the unit
carrying this standard treat their armour save as 1 point
worse than it actually is. The Totem of Rust has no
effect on Natural Armour.

magicItems.name: Preyseeker
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard automatically enters the
battlefield when using the Ambushers special rule (no
roll is needed).

loresOfMagic.attribute:
Each time a spell from the Lore of the Wild is
successfully cast, all friendly units with the Primal
Fury special rule within 6" gain a +1 Leadership bonus
to their Primal Fury tests in the following close combat
phase. This bonus is cumulative.

General only. The character gains a Magical Ward (5+).

attempts they make.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Roaring Brute
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Enemy units within 6" of this character suffer -1 to
their Leadership.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Eater Of Heroes
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character may re-roll To Hit and To Wound when
fighting in challenges.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Rune Of The Beast Ascendant
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Beastlord or Wargor only. Friendly units of Gors,
Ungors and Bestigors within 6" of the character gain
+1 Leadership.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Gnarled Hide
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character gains the Natural Armour (5+) special
rule.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Oracle Of The Dark Tongue
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Enemy units in base contact with this character cannot
use the Inspiring Presence special rule.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Rampant Juggernaut
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character gains the Devastating Charge and
Mighty Blow (1) special rules in any turn that they
make a successful charge.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Many-Limbed Fiend
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character gains +1 Attack.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Gorger
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Every time the character rolls a 6 To Wound and slays a
model, they regain one Wound lost previously during
the game.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Gouge-Tusks
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character gains the Armour Piercing (1) special
rule.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Rune Of The Insatiable Beast
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character can re-roll To Wound rolls of 1 in Close
Combat.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Rune Of The True Beast
gifts_of_chaos.description:
War Beasts, Swarms and any mounts are not allowed to
target the character in close combat, although any
riders may attack as normal.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Slug-Skin
gifts_of_chaos.description:
All enemy models in base contact with the character at
the start of any round of close combat suffer a Strength
2 hit with the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Malevolent Despoiler
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Enemy units in combat with this character gain no
benefits from fighting behind Obstacles.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Shadow-Hide
gifts_of_chaos.description:
Model on foot only. Enemy models targeting the
character with missile attacks suffer a -1 To Hit
modifier.

gifts_of_chaos.name: Uncanny Senses
gifts_of_chaos.description:
The character gains +2 Initiative.
